text.en:
The Public Estates Authority is hereby transferred from the
Department of Public Works and Highways and attached to the Department.of

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 19th day of July in the year of our Lord,
two thousand and four.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 26716
